tools.name: catnat_lookup
tools.description: Use this when you need to know whether a natural disaster was officially recognised in a French commune and if there is still time to file the home-insurance claim. For 1 to 50 communes (INSEE codes): the CatNat decrees whose claim window is open and the latest decree (Journal officiel), with peril
